subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

I knew very little Spanish __when I came here, but__ I have been learning and can now make myself understood.

options.text: as soon as I came here, but

solution:
The correct answer is** 'No improvement required'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined part 'when I came here' is correctly used and the given sentence is grammatically correct.
 
• In the given sentence the primary clause is in the **simple past tense.**
 
• Accordingly, 'came' is used here.
 
• The conjunction '**when**' means used for talking about the time at which something happens or happened. (जब, जिस समय या वक़्त)
 
 
• *Example: I don’t know **when** she arrived.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 3.**
